GLYPH FLOW DOCUMENT v1
Read glyph_flow_read for the current complete document, revision and strategy registry. Keep content state when editing configuration. Use only registered strategies; unknown fields/names fail validation.

Root: {version:1,title,contracts:{name:schema},components:[],connections:[],obstacles:[]}.
Component: {id,title,position:{x,y,width,height},spin,stateContract,initial,state,methods:{name:{input,output,handler:{type,...options},interaction?}},output:{type,contract},layout:{type,...options}}.
Contracts are names in contracts or inline closed schemas. Schema types: object/array/string/number/integer/boolean/null. Object schemas need properties and additionalProperties:false. Optional required; array items/minItems/maxItems; string minLength/maxLength; numeric minimum/maximum; enum. No $ref/pattern/union/code. Max 64KiB JSON, 10 components, 32 contracts, 16 methods/component, 24 connections, 3 obstacles. Coordinates are percentages, every box fits 0..100. Component width/height >=8. spin is radians/sec in -2..2.

Handler types:
append: array state; one input or many:true array; optional key rejects duplicates; result echoes input.
upsert: array state; key (default id), optional many:true; result echoes input.
remove: array state; input is key value or object with key; missing record rejects; result echoes input.
shuffle: array state; input {seed:uint32}; deterministically permutes records without modifying any record; result is the reordered array. Use a closed seed object input schema and array-state result schema.
replace: state=input; result=input.
group: object-of-arrays state; merge by key (default id), groupBy (default category), optional many:true; unknown groups reject; result=input.
accept-envelope: state=input; requires input.rows array and input.total===rows.length; result=input.
select: object state; sets selected=input; result=input.
Every method's result and resulting state are independently validated before commit.

Layouts: sphere/grid/helix; optional key (default id), label (default title), color, density 0..240, interactive:true to expose content marks as native buttons. grid may use columns 1..12 or groupBy/groups. Layout gets structured state and returns glyph marks. Exports: identity publishes state; flatten publishes array content; envelope publishes {rows,total}.

Connection: {id,title,from,to,method,mapping:{type:'identity'|'first'|'batch',size?}}. batch requires size1..24. from/to are distinct component ids; method exists on receiver. Mapping validates against current data. Obstacle: {id,title,position:{x,y,width,height}}.

Protocol method call: {id,component,method,payload}. A programmer defines the component interface; add is an example name, not a global requirement. Calls animate and mutate the receiver only after arrival. Staged/queued is not delivered. The browser receipt is authoritative for delivery. No arbitrary JavaScript is executed from a flow document.

Optional method interaction: {travel:"hop"|"stream",receive:"pixel-sort"|"categorize"|"none",duration:0..3,textField:"title"}. Defaults are stream/none; duration defaults to 0.9 simulated seconds, used only for a receive effect. textField names one top-level payload string, or a string payload supplies its own text. hop animates those code points along the routed path. pixel-sort is a visual reassembly phase before the typed handler commits; it does not sort application data. Lifecycle: started -> processing (optional) -> arrived/rejected/cancelled. Processing can be cancelled without a state mutation. Reduced motion skips animation and delay. Change a method's interaction with a component merge patch, preserving all other method fields and state. The word form maps a native submit event to source.add({id,title:word,category:"SIGNAL"}); interaction settings belong to this receiving method.

Interactive layout marks (at most64 per component) expose glyph-activate with {component,mark,label,position}. The flow demo binds source activation to its source->cluster connection. Document.run(connectionId,{mark}) selects the matching exported record by source layout.key (default id); first mapping sends one record, batch/identity sends a one-item array. This preserves the batch cursor and uses a fromMark origin at the projected word. Categorize is a separate stepped receiving effect, while the group handler organizes by the input category and upserts by key. Repeated clicks do not duplicate an existing keyed record. Enabling interactive layout metadata does not invent new application event bindings; custom activation routes belong in application code.

Sphere geometry: layout.reflow=true draws stable per-letter glyphs with intact record anchors. Optional shatterAt is an integer 0..4096: 0 disables, otherwise shatter occurs only when the sum of label-field Unicode code points across the array exceeds the limit (not row count, not >=). Shattered letters distribute over the spherical surface; records and their order stay intact. Below the threshold, or with shatterAt:0, letters re-form words. reflowDuration is 0.1..6 simulated seconds (default 2.8) for curved, staggered geometry transitions. These optional layout fields preserve old v1 documents when omitted. The demo adds them to its existing source while retaining state, baseline, contracts and routes.

Programmer local geometry operations: source.dispatch('shuffle',{seed:23}) validates and commits the pure seeded array permutation immediately, then visualizes the new geometry; it creates no transport flight or receipt. source.api.shuffle(...) is the ordinary animated ingress API and still travels before commit. workspace.configureLayout('source',{reflow:true,shatterAt:120,reflowDuration:2.8}) validates and changes only the existing organizer/motion, retaining DOM identity, state, revision and epoch. source.reorganize(organize,{type:'weave',duration:2.8}) is the programmer hook. source.geometry exposes active/progress; glyph-geometry emits started/settled. Pausing and offscreen visibility suspend simulation; reduced motion settles immediately. Motion can be interrupted from its current rendered coordinates. Glyph IDs must stay stable for paths to match. Organizers remain bounded to 1024 marks including scaffold and word anchors, with 64 native interactive anchors. Letter marks can carry owner (record ID), letter (index) and accessibleLabel/hitLabel on the anchor (accessible name and hit width text); the renderer delegates scattered-letter hits back to an interactive owner. The source array strip shows the actual committed order. Geometry edits preserve all content; shattering is a reversible view, not a state transform.

Component and method definitions accept optional description text (<=1000 characters) describing purpose and effects. Browser Component Agent Interface publishes these descriptions with addresses, handles, local indexes and input/result contracts. Preserve existing descriptions on unrelated edits. Browser WebMCP tools are separate from the native recipe tool connection.
